item.title: Burnham says employers will have to publish salaries on job adverts
item.body: Prime Minister Andy Burnham has announced that his government will bring in a legal requirement for companies to state what they pay when listing new jobs. It is the government's latest "small fix" to help improve people's lives.

photo.credit: Prime Minister's Office / OGL 3, Wikimedia Commons

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 📋 Burnham says employers will have to publish salaries on job adverts

Prime Minister Andy Burnham has announced that his government will bring in a legal requirement for companies to state what they pay when listing new jobs. It is the government's latest "small fix" to help improve people's lives.

Source: Guardian | Image: Prime Minister's Office / OGL 3, Wikimedia Commons
UK Daily Briefing | 6 November, 09:50
